author: Keymonte Avery
title: Baton Rouge radio host earns second national Gracie Award - NewsBreak
text:
By Keymonte Avery ,
7 hours ago
BATON ROUGE, La. (Louisiana First) — A Baton Rouge native was awarded a top Radio Honor at the Gracie Awards.
According to a release, Jodi Koontz, of Murphy Sam & Jodi , was named the National Syndicated Radio Host of 2026.
The Alliance for Women in Media Foundation founded the Gracies Award, which recognizes programming and individual achievement created by women, for women, in news and entertainment.
This marks Koontz’s second Gracie Award.
“I am thrilled to win a second Gracie and can’t stop smiling!” said Koontz. “A win for our whole team, and an honor to be recognized alongside so many women I look up to!”
Koontz will be honored at the gala event on Tuesday, May 19, at the Beverly Wilshire Four Seasons Hotel in Los Angeles, California.
Murphy Sam & Jodi is based in Baton Rouge at iHeartMedia’s 96.1 The River and is syndicated to 87 cities in the nation via Premiere Radio Networks and Media 3 Entertainment, LLC. The morning show has been broadcast since 1998, sharing pop culture, daily news, and real-life friendships.
